puzzle.hint: A profound rhetorical question about the purpose of creation and our return to Allah for accountability on the Day of Judgment.
puzzle.arabic: أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَـٰكُمْ عَبَثًۭا وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ
puzzle.verseEn: Then did you think that We created you uselessly and that to Us you would not be returned?"
